name: Abnormal Security - Emails
description: The Abnormal Security - Emails dashboard in Sumo Logic offers insights into email threat management. It shows counts of remediated emails, top threat senders and receivers, and email threat activity over time. Additionally, it visualizes the geolocation of email senders, highlighting risky regions. This helps in tracking and mitigating email-based threats efficiently.
title: Abnormal Security - Emails

panels.title: Untitled
panels.text:
Filters: 

###attack_type:  It indicates the type of attack.
###attack_vector: It describes the method used for the attack.
###attack_strategy: It specifies the strategy employed by the attacker.
###attack_party: It identifies the target of the attack.
###auto_remediated: It indicates whether the threat was automatically remediated.
###post_remediated: It represents whether the threat was remediated after the fact.
